plumbing.review:
**[P2] The CLI starts tools before rejecting explicit components.** The guard at [verify.go:201](verify.go:201) runs after [main.go:127](main.go:127) calls `toolchain.Ensure`. That executes `docker info` and can download TLC into the host cache ([toolchain.go:59](toolchain.go:59), line 67). Without Docker, users receive a Docker error instead of the promised unsupported-component error.

The acceptance test misses this because it invokes `verify.Run` directly ([components_accept_test.go:69](components_accept_test.go:69)). Reject explicit components before CLI toolchain setup and add coverage through that entry point; the plan’s allowed files will need expanding.

Otherwise, the changes stay within scope, both acceptance files match the ratified sources, and I found no test-specific shortcuts, weakened legacy checks, secret leakage, or material style mismatch. The factory reports all checks passed; I did not rerun them in this read-only review.

The merger must also record and cite the identity/selection decision, as [plan.json:3](plan.json:3) explicitly requires.

VERDICT: changes needed — reject components before CLI toolchain setup, add CLI regression coverage, and complete the merger’s decision record and citation.
